redfin.remarks: 1,500 square feet of hillside living at 877 Montecito Dr in Los Angeles. Tucked into Montecito Heights, this single-family home sits above the street with the privacy and outdoor connection that define Northeast LA. The interior offers an open living and dining area that flows toward outdoor decks and patiostypical of these canyon-side lotswith room for everyday living plus guests. Expect a practical kitchen layout, multiple bedrooms, and baths sized for the square footage, plus the kind of indoor-outdoor flow buyers look for in this pocket. The lot itself is the real asset: hillside topography with infinite potential to develop, mature landscaping and space for adding extra parking , a guest house or a home!. You're minutes from Debs Park trails, Highland Park and Figueroa dining, and a short drive to Pasadena or Downtown.
